title: Temporal impact evidence and pull watch
summary: TimeImpactAnalyzer compares two authority revisions or two explicitly injected timezone-rule services over a bounded date interval and classifies actual changed occurrences. TimeChangeWatch polls and acknowledges locally; it does not own durable transport or consumer checkpoint storage.
invariants: Separate changed intention, local wall time, UTC projection, gap/fold policy and rule snapshot.
Unrelated authority revision need not generate a change effect.
No implicit asynchronous publication; consumer persists its own watch checkpoint.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
